title: Valerie Ransone runs the Whip Inflation Now program in the Ford White House

tellings.quote: Well, when I knew her, she was working in the Gerald Ford White House.

plain: A woman named Valerie Ransone worked in Gerald Ford's White House in the mid-1970s and ran Whip Inflation Now, Ford's public campaign against rising prices. Jeffrey Mishlove, a PhD who studies psychics, UFOs and the afterlife, says he knew her at that time and tells Michels: "when I knew her, she was working in the Gerald Ford White House." He brings it up to show that someone he knew in this field had worked at the heart of government.
